_about: Vercel project settings for VeQMS. These are dashboard settings: Vercel stores them per project, not in the repository. Enter them by hand when importing the repository (see README.md).
environmentVariables: None. The app is static files and reads no environment variables.

deploymentProtection.vercelAuthentication: On, covering production as well as previews, so only members of your Vercel team can open the site
deploymentProtection.passwordProtection: Optional, if your plan includes it
deploymentProtection.samlSso: Optional, if your plan includes it (for example with Microsoft Entra ID)

inRepository.veqms/vercel.json: Security headers and noindex. Vercel reads this automatically from the root directory.
